authority.name: Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes
authority.provider: California Academy of Sciences, Institute for Biodiversity Science and Sustainability
authority.accessMethod: The public catalog edition dated 21 September 2026 was checked through indexed public record pages and direct catalog record queries where accessible. Raw catalog pages were not downloaded or retained; each record-level URL is stored below.
authority.reviewScope: Current nomenclature and family placement only. This does not re-identify specimens or validate a Bataan occurrence.

interpretation: All 42 source-printed binomial rows have a catalog nomenclature/family pass. Source names and families remain verbatim. Qualified or indirect nomenclatural cases remain explicitly provisional, the ten genus-only or hybrid rows remain held, every source-table row remains pending overall fish-identity review, and none is admitted to the app.

records.disposition: Preserve the paper row verbatim; treat catalog name/family as a nomenclature-only proposal pending independent source-identity review.
